t: The 4lite Marinus Square up and down wall light is a mains-powered outdoor luminaire designed to provide bi-directional illumination. Ideal for illuminating domestic doorways, pathways and gardens, this modern anthracite fitting enhances home security while creating an atmospheric lighting effect. The durable marine-grade stainless steel body and plastic diffuser ensure weather-resistant performance in harsh environments. An integrated 120° PIR sensor detects motion up to 7m away, automatically triggering the light. This wall-mounted fitting requires 2 x 50W GU10 bulbs and includes all necessary fixings for a straightforward installation.
b: Adjustable Light Duration of 10 Seconds to 5 Minutes
